limits: These regions establish where a pictured point lies. They do not establish full vehicle fit, permission to stop, or the probability of success on new drives. An overlapping box measures referent display, independently of destination and ambiguity. A provisional service response or a timeout receives no semantic credit.
findings: The original Donatello rear-strip target and its two wordings again yielded a guided point. The saved point was 75.206 original pixels from the separately displayed tap. Its room for a whole vehicle remains unknown.
The previously automatic white-sedan bay retained its exact earlier point, now as a selectable answer because image checks disagreed about the lane edge.

Both remaining positive wordings received an outlined plausible vehicle but no location. The red marking on the white SUV was unverified. At Dog Spot the app identified the frontage and displayed candidate vehicles while disclosing conflicting close-up readings and unknown Mini make. Overlap with one among several candidates gives partial referent credit.

The Mini-side passenger mark again saved at its exact coordinates, while the response explicitly explained that relation to the vehicle could not be checked. Three of four intended manual marks were usable. The clear marked bay behind the SUV with a door design was withheld as a footpath.
All six lane/aisle taps and the uncertain gravel tap withheld. No wrong location, service error or timeout was observed. This is a matched development replay on the already-opened photographs.
